T0428.title: Credit-Fraud Service Fee Rate
T0428.definition: In credit fraud or loan-packaging chains, the service-fee percentage charged by brokers according to operational risk and expected deal value.
T0428.description:
Credit-fraud service fee rate expresses the percentage charged for loan packaging, approval facilitation, debt-assumption schemes, or channel brokerage. The rate changes with customer profile, loan size, document-fabrication difficulty, channel concealment, and the chance of risk-control interception; higher risk or higher expected return usually leads to a higher rate.

It is a key language for pricing risk, allocating commissions, and recruiting agents in credit-fraud networks. Controls focus on intermediary quote monitoring, abnormal service-fee detection, packaging-channel profiling, and end-to-end tracing of loan application flows.

references.title: 2024 H1 Credit Fraud Risk Landscape Report

T0428.usageExample: Credit-Fraud Service Fee Rate rises when loan-packaging difficulty and risk-control interception probability increase.
